args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since deploying v2.3.1 to production (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production deploy and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback succeeded (`status: rolled_out`), and the service is now **healthy** with an error rate of 0.002.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** — "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy" — describing the failure and the rollback to v2.3.0. (The initial API call timed out, but I verified the incident was created and is open.)

Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging, which aligns with v2.3.1 being a bad release. The rollback to v2.3.0 was the correct action since it was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
